collection.title: Vauxhall Astra Hatchback 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Astra Hatchback 2021 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Astra, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
